subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` as a public diagnostics config key, and should changes hot-apply to future queued entries or require restart?
rationale: The remaining work adds public configuration surface, and repository policy treats config/default additions and reload semantics as maintainer-owned compatibility decisions.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, and reload planning all agree that changed values apply to future queue entries.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Keep the config key but document and test restart-required behavior instead of promising config reload semantics.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Keep the threshold fixed or solve log noise through another diagnostics policy, then close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, and reload planning all agree that changed values apply to future queue entries.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided item-specific guidance on the queue/config/docs/test shape and appears in the relevant feature history.
